rows.name: Intel(R) Dynamic Tuning Technology Telemetry Service

rows.name: Microsoft Edge Update Service (edgeupdate)

rows.name: Intel(R) Graphics Command Center Service

rows.name: Intel Analytics Service

rows.name: Intel Connectivity Network Service

rows.name: Intel(R) Graphics Display Service

rows.name: Intel(R) Innovation Platform Framework Service

rows.name: MySQL80

rows.name: Intel(R) Storage Middleware Service

rows.name: Realtek Audio Universal Service

rows.name: Safe Exam Browser Service

rows.name: Intel(R) Management Engine WMI Provider Registration

rows.name: GlideX Service

rows.name: GlideX Remote Service
